_what: Ten-Percent Days 3.0 v2 FORWARD test pass bars, locked 2026-09-15 before the first forward session (2026-09-16). The v1 walk-forward (thresholds_lock.json) failed every head; per its policy re-evaluation is only a new locked run. This run is judged only on sessions scored and frozen before they opened. Editing any value after a forward session has been graded voids the test.
supersedes: thresholds_lock.json for the forward test only; the v1 walk-forward verdict stands
decisions: v2 change: market features over point-in-time universe members only (user)
heads: the two 1-day heads; 5-day heads dropped, not logged (user)
mechanics: frozen daily snapshots, local host cron, judged after 60 graded sessions (user)
model_changes_vs_v1: mkt_ret1 and breadth computed over the target session's point-in-time universe members instead of every EQ stock

scoring.manifest: sha256 of the predictions file, lock sha256, git sha, fold month, data_as_of, generated_at
scoring.not_frozen_in_time: session excluded from grading and counted
scoring.stale_or_partial_data: no snapshot for that session (refusal logged and counted)

retrain.training_rows: label horizon ends before the first session of the month

precision_at_k: pooled: sum of hits in each session's top-k / sum of min(k, eligible); probability desc, symbol asc

p_up10_1d_vs_fixed_baseline.baseline: research GBM with the A4 and A5 fixes, scored and frozen forward on the same sessions

regimes.why: 60 sessions cannot fill volatility x trend cells; reported for information only

insufficient: fewer than 60 graded sessions by evaluate_by -> NOT_EVALUATED; extending needs a new lock
